title: Microbial Digital Library: an open, self-hosted system for managing microbial culture collections
description:
A free web application for keeping track of a laboratory culture collection. It records where each strain is stored, prints labels whose code a phone camera reads, works out when strains are due for revival, and keeps a dated history of revival checks, Gram stains and plate photographs. Strain lists can be imported from a spreadsheet, and plate photographs can be turned into 3D models. Each laboratory runs its own installation on its own computer or server, and nothing is sent anywhere else.

It has not been validated for regulated (GLP or GMP) record keeping.
